sara: Heads up: sample-app release pipeline is red. publish job failing in the typegen step after the v2.1.0 semver bump. CI blocking the cut.
tom: can you share the failing artifacts / diff?
sara: pasted from the job: ```TypeGenVerificationError: regeneration mismatch
--- a/packages/sample-app/src/generated.ts
+++ b/packages/sample-app/src/generated.ts
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
-// Generated by typegen v1.3.4
+// Generated by typegen v1.3.4
+// Changelog: - Minor improvements
```
anil: interesting, why would changelog text be in generated.ts header? typegen shouldn't embed changelog content.
meera: we changed the onboarding README formatting yesterday in the samplekit; maybe that update included a changelog snippet that a prepublish hook picks up.
tom: also note we merged the auth/retry reorder in runtime last week. could metadata ordering change any embedded comments? seems unlikely but worth checking.
sara: i ran `yarn regen --check` locally and got the same mismatch. the only difference is a trailing hyphen/space in the changelog bullet: `- Minor improvements` vs `-  Minor improvements` (two spaces). that extra space appears in the generated header comment.
anil: argh. trivial whitespace flipping CI. this will block any release until fixed.
meera: root cause: typegen includes a header comment synthesized from package metadata, and the header builder doesn't normalize whitespace before hashing.
tom: fix options: 1) sanitize header content (trim/normalize whitespace) before computing the expected artifact hash; 2) remove non-essential metadata from header entirely; 3) add linter rules to prevent changelog formatting drift.
sara: short-term: i'll pin the publish workflow to `redwood/typegen@v1.3.2` (older behavior) so the current release can go out. i'll open the sanitizer PR for the generator.
anil: long-term: we should ensure typegen's output is deterministic and doesn't depend on markdown whitespace. add a unit test that regenerates with multiple changelog variants and asserts equality.
meera: i'll add a CI job in the samplekit repo that runs `yarn regen --check` on PRs modifying docs or package metadata. also update the sampleapp CONTRIBUTING.md to remind devs to `yarn regen`.
tom: note to devex: maybe expose a small CLI check `typegen --normalize-header` to run locally as a dev helper.

anil: ack, will start on tests.
meera: ack, will add CI job and README note.
